Age Determination.question: 1) The most reliable method for age determination is:
Age Determination.exp: Ossification study is the most reliable method for age determination. It is commonly assessed radiologically.

Age Determination.question: 2) Forensic radiology mainly deals with determination of:
Age Determination.exp: Forensic radiology is commonly used for age estimation by studying ossification centres and epiphyseal fusion. This pattern was also seen in 48th BCS.

Age Determination.question: 3) The best method for age estimation in children is:
Age Determination.exp: Dentition is very useful for age estimation in children. Eruption pattern of milk and permanent teeth gives important age clues.

Age Determination.question: 4) Postnatal age determination commonly includes:
Age Determination.exp: Teeth are one of the important methods for postnatal age determination. Other postnatal methods include ossification and secondary sexual characters.

Age Determination.question: 5) Ossification of bones is used for:
Age Determination.exp: Ossification centres and epiphyseal fusion are used for postnatal age estimation. X-ray examination is commonly used for this purpose.

Age Determination.question: 6) Secondary sexual characteristics are useful in:
Age Determination.exp: Secondary sexual characteristics help estimate age around puberty. They are supportive, not as reliable as ossification study.

Age Determination.question: 7) General development is used as a method of:
Age Determination.exp: General development can help estimate age, especially in children and adolescents. It is less precise than dentition or ossification.

Age Determination.question: 8) The most accurate fetal age estimation method in the file is:
Age Determination.exp: CRL or crown–heel length is listed as the most accurate method for fetal age estimation. It is used before birth.

Age Determination.question: 9) Prenatal age determination can be done by:
Age Determination.exp: Hasse’s law is used for fetal age estimation before birth. Teeth eruption and bone fusion are postnatal methods.

Age Determination.question: 10) Fundal height helps in determination of:
Age Determination.exp: Height of uterus or fundal height is used for prenatal age estimation. It gives an approximate idea of gestational age.

Age Determination.question: 11) Ultrasonogram is useful for:
Age Determination.exp: Ultrasonogram is one of the methods for age determination before birth. It is used to estimate gestational age.

Age Determination.question: 12) In a newborn aged 0–6 months, the usual dental finding is:
Age Determination.exp: From 0–6 months, there are usually no teeth, with neonatal gum pads present. Milk teeth begin erupting later.

Age Determination.question: 13) Milk teeth are usually complete by about:
Age Determination.exp: Milk teeth erupt from around 6 months and total 20 by about 2.5 years. This is a common dental age landmark.

Age Determination.question: 14) Total number of milk teeth is:
Age Determination.exp: The deciduous or milk dentition contains 20 teeth. These are usually complete by about 2.5 years.

Age Determination.question: 15) Mixed dentition is usually seen between:
Age Determination.exp: Mixed dentition means both milk and permanent teeth are present. It is usually seen between 6 and 12 years.

Age Determination.question: 16) All permanent teeth except third molars are usually present after:
Age Determination.exp: After 12 years, permanent teeth are usually present except the third molars. Third molars erupt later and are variable.

Age Determination.question: 17) Third molars are also called:
Age Determination.exp: Third molars are commonly called wisdom teeth. Their eruption is variable and usually occurs in late adolescence or early adulthood.

Age Determination.question: 18) Fully erupted third molars indicate age above:
Age Determination.exp: Fully erupted third molars indicate that the person is above 17 years of age. However, eruption timing is variable.

Age Determination.question: 19) Third molars usually erupt between:
Age Determination.exp: Third molars usually erupt between 17 and 25 years. Their eruption is variable, so they are supportive rather than absolute.

Age Determination.question: 20) Fusion of elbow joint usually occurs at about:
Age Determination.exp: Elbow joint fusion occurs at about 16 years. Joint fusion is assessed by ossification study.

Age Determination.question: 21) Fusion of ankle joint usually occurs at:
Age Determination.exp: Ankle joint fusion occurs around 16–17 years. It helps in age estimation in adolescents.

Age Determination.question: 22) Fusion of hip joint usually occurs at:
Age Determination.exp: Hip joint fusion occurs around 17–18 years. It is one of the important skeletal age markers.

Age Determination.question: 23) Fusion of knee joint usually occurs at:
Age Determination.exp: Knee joint fusion occurs around 18–19 years. Shoulder and wrist also fuse around the same age group.

Age Determination.question: 24) Fusion of shoulder joint usually occurs at:
Age Determination.exp: Shoulder joint fusion occurs around 18–19 years. This age group also includes knee and wrist fusion.

Age Determination.question: 25) Fusion of wrist joint usually occurs at:
Age Determination.exp: Wrist joint fusion occurs around 18–19 years. It is assessed radiologically during age estimation.

Age Determination.question: 26) Fusion of iliac crest occurs at:
Age Determination.exp: Iliac crest fusion occurs around 20–21 years. This age group also includes ischial tuberosity and clavicle fusion.

Age Determination.question: 27) Fusion of ischial tuberosity occurs at:
Age Determination.exp: Ischial tuberosity fusion occurs around 20–21 years. It is useful in late adolescent age estimation.

Age Determination.question: 28) Fusion of clavicle occurs at about:
Age Determination.exp: Clavicle fusion occurs around 20–21 years according to the uploaded file. Medial clavicle is also an important late-fusing epiphysis.

Age Determination.question: 29) The last epiphysis to fuse in the body is:
Age Determination.exp: The medial epiphysis of clavicle is the last epiphysis to fuse. It is important in late adolescent and young adult age estimation.

Age Determination.question: 30) The most useful X-ray for age estimation is:
Age Determination.exp: The file lists X-ray pelvis as the most useful X-ray for age estimation. Pelvic bones show important ossification and fusion changes.

Age Determination.question: 31) Medical termination of pregnancy is medicolegally related to:
Age Determination.exp: The file lists 20 weeks as the medicolegal age related to medical termination of pregnancy. It is a common legal-age recall point.

Age Determination.question: 32) Age of criminal responsibility is:
Age Determination.exp: The age of criminal responsibility is 7 years. Below this age, criminal responsibility is not established.

Age Determination.question: 33) Minimum age for employment is:
Age Determination.exp: The minimum age for employment is 14 years. This is a direct medicolegal age point.

Age Determination.question: 34) Juvenile offence is related to age:
Age Determination.exp: Juvenile offence is related to 16 years in the uploaded file. It is one of the important medicolegal age landmarks.

Age Determination.question: 35) Age of majority is:
Age Determination.exp: A person attains majority at 18 years. The same age is also related to voting age and marriage age for girls in the file.

Age Determination.question: 36) Voting age is:
Age Determination.exp: Voting age is 18 years. It is also the age of majority according to the uploaded notes.

Age Determination.question: 37) Age of marriage for girls is:
Age Determination.exp: Age of marriage for girls is listed as 18 years. It is grouped with majority and voting age.

Age Determination.question: 38) Age of marriage for boys is:
Age Determination.exp: Age of marriage for boys is 21 years. This is a commonly tested medicolegal age.

Age Determination.question: 39) Minimum age for becoming Member of Parliament is:
Age Determination.exp: The minimum age for Member of Parliament is 25 years. It is an important constitutional medicolegal age.

Age Determination.question: 40) Minimum age for becoming President is:
Age Determination.exp: The minimum age for President is 35 years. It is listed under medicolegal importance of age.
